title: M1 BAU batch — 2 ISSs (1 config.json patch + baseline seed, 1 monitoring-only OBE confirmation)
target: monitor/config.json tracked-pages expansion (killshot/audit/review-response) with seeded monitor/baseline/*.txt files (ISS-2963); WIN-062 duplicate-numbering monitoring confirmation, no patch needed (ISS-2961)

patches.description: Expand target.pages array with 3 new entries (killshot, audit, review-response) so poller Step 5b covered-pages (docs/killshot.html, docs/audit.html, docs/review-response.html) get true before/after baseline diffs instead of spot-check-only. Companion baseline files monitor/baseline/08-killshot.txt, 09-audit.txt, 10-review-response.txt seeded from live fetch of https://john09289.github.io/predictions/{killshot,audit,review-response} (2026-07-11, HTTP 200 each) — same raw-HTML-source format as the existing 7 baseline files (fetched verbatim, no processing).

obe_resolutions.finding: Re-fetched https://john09289.github.io/predictions/wins (2026-07-11) and confirmed the WIN-062 duplicate-numbering state described in ISS-2961 is still present and unchanged: two distinct <h3> entries both labeled WIN-062 — id="win-062" ("Tesla Longitudinal Wave Speed = 1.574c") and id="win-062-constant" ("Tesla Longitudinal Constant (1.574c)") — sharing data-claim-key="win-062-tesla-wave-speed". No author-side split into a distinct WIN-062B number has occurred (no such id/heading exists on the page), unlike the WIN-057/057b and WIN-058/058b precedents cited in the routing reason. Our WIN-062 verdict entry (Misleading) already covers the underlying Tesla 1.574c claim regardless of which dome write-up id it maps to, per the suggested_fix — no patch to data/wins.json is needed. This item is watch-and-note only; recommend decider leave ISS-2961 open (or close as monitoring-ongoing) rather than mark resolved, since the point of the issue is continued observation for a possible future split, not a one-time fix.
obe_resolutions.verification: grep -c "WIN-062" against a fresh fetch of https://john09289.github.io/predictions/wins returns 2 <h3> hits, ids win-062 and win-062-constant, both data-claim-key="win-062-tesla-wave-speed"; zero hits for any "062b"/"062-b" id or heading variant.

tldr_evidence: ISS-2963: poller Step 5b names 5 load-bearing pages (killshot/wins/predictions/audit/review-response.html) but config.json only tracked 7 unrelated pages (home/wins/predictions/coordinates/model/evolution/ai-context) — wins and predictions were already covered, killshot/audit/review-response were not. Live fetch of all 3 missing pages succeeded (HTTP 200); content seeded as new baseline files. ISS-2961: re-verified live that WIN-062 duplicate-id state (win-062 / win-062-constant, same data-claim-key) is unchanged since the 2026-07-10 integrity finding — no author-side split yet, no verdict impact.
tldr_verdict: ISS-2963 resolved with a config.json + baseline-file patch (poller can now true-diff all 5 Step-5b-covered pages). ISS-2961 confirmed as still-accurate monitoring note requiring no content change — the underlying Tesla 1.574c claim is unaffected regardless of dome-side numbering.
investigation_notes: Confirmed via https://john09289.github.io/predictions/killshot spot-check that the known CSS-class mismatch flagged in ISS-1155 (green status-confirmed class under STRUCTURAL SUPPORT / SUPPORTIVE ONLY text for Sydney-Perth rail + Polaris elevation rows) is still present — matches ISS-2963 description of already-processed prior state, not new, so no additional action taken on that sub-point.

Existing config.json page URLs follow a no-.html-suffix pattern (e.g. .../wins not .../wins.html); confirmed the same pattern resolves correctly for killshot/audit/review-response (all HTTP 200) before adding entries, rather than guessing from the docs/*.html naming used in poller.md Step 5b (which refers to file paths in the john09289/predictions repo docs/ folder, not URL paths).
Baseline files written as-fetched (raw HTML source, trailing newline, no extraction/processing) matching the format of the existing 01-home.txt through 07-ai-context.txt baseline files.
test_coverage: tests/run.sh — patch only adds config.json page entries + new baseline text files; no data/wins.json, data/sections.json, layer counts, rates, or classifier changes. Ran node -e JSON.parse validation on monitor/config.json and monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker.json.
